name: excelsupreme
description: Excel Supreme — zero-signup, in-browser Excel practice drills with deterministic grading

scripts.check: npm test && npm run content:check && npm run next:build && npm run budget && npm run next:check && npm run origin:check && npm run secret:check && node legacy/src/verify.mjs
scripts.content:check: node packages/content-lint/cli.js check && node packages/content-lint/cli.js legal
scripts.db:check: supabase db reset && node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/db/rls.spec.js tests/db/auth.spec.js tests/db/progress.spec.js tests/db/migrate.spec.js tests/db/profile.spec.js tests/db/legal.spec.js tests/db/institution.spec.js tests/db/stripe.spec.js tests/db/retention.spec.js tests/db/leaderboard.spec.js tests/db/challenge.spec.js tests/db/certificate.spec.js
scripts.next:dev: npm run build && node scripts/next-assets.mjs && next dev
scripts.next:build: npm run build && node scripts/next-assets.mjs && next build
